description:
Jasper is the marketing agents platform, built to help enterprises orchestrate AI agents that execute marketing work at scale. Purpose-built for marketing teams, Jasper enables faster, more consistent execution across campaigns, personalization, localization, and compliance—while maintaining enterprise-grade control and governance.

Jasper is trusted by hundreds of enterprises worldwide, including Prudential, Cushman & Wakefield, and nearly 20% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 2021, Jasper has team members across the U.S., Australia, and France.

About The Role

As a Senior Accountant at Jasper, you will play a key role on our Accounting team in a fast-growing, high-impact environment. You will hold core ownership across our monthly close, general ledger operations, and balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring our financial foundation operates with rigor and scale. In this role, you will partner cross-functionally across the business to streamline processes, enhance internal workflows, and support Jasper’s continued growth.

This fully remote role reports to the Controller and is open to candidates located anywhere in the US.

 What you will do at Jasper

  • Lead an accurate and timely month-end close by preparing journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations across cash, prepaids, accruals, intercompany, fixed assets, and other general ledger accounts

  • Manage close workflows, task tracking, and balance sheet reconciliations within Numeric to drive close efficiency and transparency

  • Oversee corporate card transactions, employee expense reimbursements, and accounts payable workflows utilizing Ramp

  • Reconcile subscription billing, SaaS metrics, and payment gateway transactions within Maxio

  • Maintain equity transaction records, stock-based compensation schedules, and capitalization table reporting in Carta

  • Oversee monthly variable compensation calculations and proper accounting treatment (ASC 340)

  • Ensure accounting records, policies, and operational processes adhere strictly to US GAAP and maintain sound internal controls

  • Partner cross-functionally across departments to capture transaction details, investigate reconciling items, and resolve operational variances

  • Support the annual financial statement audit, tax filings, and external compliance requirements

  • Assist with ad-hoc financial reporting, system enhancements, and special projects as needed

What you will bring to Jasper

  • AI fluency — a working understanding of core AI concepts (LLMs, agents, copilots, tokens, credits, context windows, RAG, data governance, etc.), applied in the context of accounting, financial operations, and workflow automation

  • Active CPA license (required)

  • 3+ years of progressive general ledger accounting experience, ideally in a fast-paced technology or high-growth SaaS environment

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field of study

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, month-end close procedures, and account reconciliation best practices

  • Direct, hands-on experience with modern cloud ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)

  • Direct experience working with modern financial and accounting tooling (such as Ramp for spend management, Numeric for close management, Maxio for SaaS billing/revenue, and Carta for equity administration) or comparable platforms

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

  • High attention to detail and ability to operate independently with minimal direction

  • Prior public accounting experience (Big 4 or national firm) strongly preferred

  • Exposure to technical accounting areas (e.g., ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 340 capitalized commissions, equity accounting) is a plus 

Compensation Range

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is $101,250–$118,750. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage beginning on the first day for employees and their families

  • 401(k) program with up to 2% company matching

  • Equity grant participation

  • Flexible PTO with a FlexExperience budget ($900 annually) to help you make the most of your time away from work

  • FlexWellness program ($1,800 annually) to help support your personal health goals

  • Generous budget for home office set up

  • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

Our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels as we know the more inclusive we are, the better our product will be. We are committed to celebrating and supporting our differences and that diversity is essential to innovation and makes us better able to serve our customers. We hire people of all levels and backgrounds who are excited to learn and develop their skills. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that you have reviewed and agree to Jasper's CCPA Notice to Candidates, available at legal.jasper.ai/#ccpa.
